description:
CI proves the workspace on its exact declared compiler, and one tested command reports whether that declaration has fallen behind current stable.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Workspace `rust-version` is 1.97 unless the stable comparison requires a refresh, and every Rust crate inherits that single declaration.
- [hard] REQ-02: The exact-MSRV job derives its compiler from Cargo metadata and builds and tests the committed workspace — including `axum-server`, `tokio-util`, and the committed `Cargo.lock` — with that compiler.
- [hard] REQ-03: A deterministic command derives current stable at run time, emits the declared and stable versions in machine-readable form, and fails when the declared minor is newer than stable or when stable exceeds the declaration by more than one minor release. Unit fixtures cover current, one-behind, too-old, and future values.
- [hard] REQ-04: The command is reusable by CI and by the pre-tag check, and one canonical policy documents its derivation and refresh procedure without copying the current stable number into workflow configuration or additional prose.

## Notes

Blast radius: root `Cargo.toml`, the existing MSRV CI job, a focused version-policy script and its tests, and the canonical release-policy page.
title: Enforce the declared MSRV recency window
